speech_en: A little sticker for a big brave check-up!
speech_de: Ein kleines Pflaster für einen großen, tapferen Check!
scenario: A cheerful cat sits proudly on a vet's exam table getting a small heart-shaped sticker placed on its shoulder by a friendly hand (sleeve + hand only, no full person/face, matching the set's no-full-human-figure rule). A little round friendly FeLV-virus character with short blunt rounded studs (never spikes/rays) floats nearby in the same room, small and harmless, waving hello — mirrors the set's 'show how it's dealt with, not the harm' convention (a routine check, not a bite or illness) rather than depicting sickness. No window, door, box or any edge-to-edge rectangle anywhere in the scene — just the cat, the hand and the little virus character filling the whole canvas.

prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080.

THIS IS A MACRO CLOSE-UP SHOT, LIKE A ZOOMED-IN PHONE CAMERA PHOTO TAKEN TOO CLOSE. The subject is so close to the "camera" that it does NOT fully fit in the frame: the cat's ears/head are CUT OFF by the TOP edge, the cat's body is CUT OFF by the LEFT and RIGHT edges, and the cat's paws are CUT OFF by the BOTTOM edge. There must be ZERO empty white background space visible anywhere in the image — every single part of the 1080x1080 canvas is covered by either black line-art or white space that belongs INSIDE a drawn shape (fur, sleeve, virus body). If you can see plain empty background at any edge, the drawing is WRONG — redo it bigger and closer.

DO NOT draw any rectangle, box, window, door, frame or panel edge of any kind, anywhere — not around the whole picture, and not as a prop inside the scene either. There is no furniture, no window, no door in this picture at all: only the cat, the hand, and the little virus character, drawn directly against each other with no dividing lines.

SCENE (draw it oversized, then let the crop cut it): A happy cartoon CAT sits proudly, chest puffed out, tail curled, eyes closed in a contented smile. A friendly hand (just a sleeve cuff and hand, NO face, NO full human body anywhere) reaches in from the RIGHT edge, its sleeve cuff CUT OFF by the right edge of the canvas, placing a small heart-shaped sticker on the cat's shoulder. The cat fills nearly the entire width and height, touching or crossing all four edges. In the bottom-right corner, large and close to the hand (not separated by any line or shape), floats a big round FRIENDLY cartoon FeLV-virus character — draw it BIG, at least as large as the cat's head, so its studs are CUT OFF by the right edge and bottom edge of the canvas: a simple smooth ball with a cheerful face (two dot eyes, small smile) and only five or six SHORT, BLUNT, ROUNDED stud bumps sitting flush and close to its body like little knuckles — NOT spikes, NOT rays, NOT thorns. It waves one stubby bump hello, calm and harmless. The RIGHT edge of the canvas must be crossed by at least three separate elements (the hand/sleeve, the sticker, and the virus character) with NO gap of white space between them along that edge. Keep the background completely bare (no props, no furniture, no window, no door) so the cat, the hand and the little virus character are the only shapes, and they must be enormous relative to the canvas, touching every edge with no gaps.

STYLE — coloring book line art: BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed. NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black fills anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only). Simple, cheerful, chunky shapes with open white space INSIDE each shape for colouring.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN:
- Any visible empty white background, wall, sky or margin space — the artwork must be so zoomed-in and oversized that it touches or crosses every one of the four edges, with elements literally cut off by the edges.
- ANY rectangle, box outline, window, door, picture frame, panel edge, border line or vignette anywhere in the image, including around the whole picture.
- ANY starburst, radiating burst, sparkle rays, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, or halo of rays anywhere.
- Virus rim bumps drawn as pointed spikes, thorns or anything radiating outward — short blunt rounded studs only, close to the body.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks.
- NO speech bubble or thought bubble (added separately afterwards).
- NO needles, no visible medical tools, no blood, no sick or sad animal, no fighting or biting.
- NO full human figure or human face anywhere — hand and sleeve cuff only.
- The virus character never touches, bites or chases the cat.
